Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform roles and permissions

This page lists the IAM roles and permissions for Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. To search through all roles and permissions, see the role and permission index.

Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform roles

Role Permissions

Agent Platform Administrator

(roles/aiplatform.admin)

Grants full access to all resources in Agent Platform.
